headline_findings: THE ANSWER TO 'CAN YOU GET A MARKER ONTO THE MAP' IS YES. Through the ordinary save door: saveState() -> world.discovery.cells := an all-ones raster, world.discovery.places := all 42 poi ids -> loadState(). ZERO dropped by the live-world load audit. The map then draws 42 place squares, 35 of them for places the body never stood in, over a FULLY RENDERED province. AMENDMENT-W1-MAP-01 §3a makes 'a square for a place the player has not stood in' and 'terrain rendered where the player has not been' hard fails in one sentence. map-probe.mjs L3 is the check built to catch this and it forges only the PLACE LIST while leaving the raster honest — but the raster is in the same blob, so the corroboration is a fixed-point test on its own input.

THE API EXISTS AND THE FILE SAYS IT DOES NOT. Discovery has FOUR state-writing methods (observe/0, suspend/0, resume/0, restore/1). restore(blob) rebuilds the place list from ids the caller supplies. The header's 'observe() ... the only mutator' and 'every mutating method on this object has arity 0' are both false as written, and restore is the one route the builder's own tryPlaceMapMarker never tries.

THE REGISTER-NOT-THE-PICTURE SHAPE, TWICE. (1) getUIState().map.mutator_arities — the exact field AMENDMENT §3b tells a critic to read from the running object instead of trusting the source — is a hand-written literal {observe, suspend, resume} and omits restore. (2) ui-metrics.mjs picks its stem-measurement region from a four-kind whitelist, so `sheet` and `spells` return 0 samples in every completed configuration, and the grader FILTERS THEM OUT of the median and reports PASS.

NO W1-21 DETECTOR OPENS THE MAP. ui-layer (8 viewpoints), ui-metrics (6 screens), ui-forbidden (4 menus), marker-diff (no menu open), ui-census (world/combat/levelup). Five detectors, zero visits, on the surface S35 defines by its refusals.

THE PAUSED SCREEN STILL DOES NOT REDRAW ON A MODEL CHANGE. W1-MAP fixed the FOCUS half with focusSignature in build()'s cache key — real, re-confirmed, 55,656 px. Engine._afterStep() applies ui.pending (use/transfer/level/equip) on PAUSED frames and none of those touches focus[mode].
